lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of increased pixel intensity intersecting with the centroid blobs, creating a series of anchor nodes across the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Visible longitudinal ridges on the upper lateral flank, defined by a sharp intensity transition from high-luminance upper edges to shadowed lower boundaries.
